name: MEA Local — Extracted Notification Service (Quarkus)
_comment: FORWARD-REFERENCE (notification-plan.md S4+, not yet exercised by S2): points the SAME behavior-equivalence suite at the extracted Quarkus Notification service (examples/03-notification-service/) once it exists, on its own port so it can run side-by-side with the monolith during the strangler cutover. Only the Notification Context Contract folder is meaningful against this target until checkout itself is routed here. The folder's bounded-wait poll (DRQ-037) is written to pass against EITHER backend unchanged: immediately against the synchronous monolith (local.postman_environment.json), and after a short delay here once the outbox -> Kafka -> SmallRye consumer path is live — the collection itself must NOT change (that is the equivalence gate, DRQ-014). Update `baseUrl` here (and/or point it at the Camel strangler proxy's Notification route) once S6/S7 stand the cutover up.
